key_points.silo_note: This is relevant to derivative_pricing only insofar as structured-product valuation or regime classification could benefit from richer feature representations, but the paper does not test pricing models directly.

key_points.silo_note: In derivative_pricing, faster processing could matter for large scenario sets or repeated recalibration loops, though the paper’s evidence is illustrative rather than pricing-specific.
